import math

def find_kth_divisor(n: int, k: int) -> int:
    divisors = []
    for i in range(1, int(math.sqrt(n)) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            divisors.append(i)
            if i != n // i:
                divisors.append(n // i)
    
    divisors.sort()
    
    if k > len(divisors):
        return -1
    return divisors[k - 1]
